Crustdata’s public docs currently cover three API areas: Company, Person, and Web. You can search and enrich companies, search and enrich people, resolve companies from known identifiers, build filter UIs with autocomplete, and search or fetch content from public webpages.

The public guides in this docs site focus on indexed Company and Person
workflows plus the Web APIs. Company and Person live endpoints are
enterprise-only and plan-specific. Review [Pricing](https://docs.crustdata.com/general/pricing) before
you build a live workflow.

## [​](https://docs.crustdata.com/general/introduction\#what-you-can-do-with-the-public-apis)  What you can do with the public APIs

- Build targeted account and prospect lists with structured company and person search.
- Resolve company records from domains, names, profile URLs, or IDs.
- Enrich known companies and people before outreach, routing, or research.
- Power filter builders and search UX with autocomplete endpoints.
- Search the web or fetch page content, then pass identifiers into Company or Person workflows.

## [​](https://docs.crustdata.com/general/introduction\#api-areas-in-this-docs-site)  API areas in this docs site

- [Company APIs](https://docs.crustdata.com/company-docs/quickstart) — search, identify, enrich, and autocomplete company records.
- [Person APIs](https://docs.crustdata.com/person-docs/quickstart) — search, enrich, and autocomplete people records.
- [Web APIs](https://docs.crustdata.com/web-docs/quickstart) — search the web and fetch webpage content.

## [​](https://docs.crustdata.com/general/introduction\#common-starting-points)  Common starting points

- Start with [Company quickstart](https://docs.crustdata.com/company-docs/quickstart) if you need company search, identify, or enrich workflows.
- Start with [Person quickstart](https://docs.crustdata.com/person-docs/quickstart) if you need people search or enrich workflows.
- Start with [Web quickstart](https://docs.crustdata.com/web-docs/quickstart) if you need web search or page fetch workflows.
- Review [Pricing](https://docs.crustdata.com/general/pricing) before you estimate production usage.
- Open the [API reference](https://docs.crustdata.com/openapi-specs/2025-11-01/introduction) for headers, versioning, and endpoint details.
